addendum_surface_results.11_post_read9_semantics: SURVIVES: every post-read-9 failure banks TERMINAL_FAILURE with reason, ledger 175, receipts+retention intact, output NO_OUTPUT_AUTHORITY, distinguishable from COMPLETE; no retry path; crash case reconstructs 175 from receipts (needs N8 terminalizer)
addendum_surface_results.12_storage_exhaustion: SURVIVES accounting-wise: ENOSPC on retention leaves the receipted read truthfully counted; ENOSPC on receipt write/fsync aborts before publish (unreceipted = uncounted by definition); footprint ~133 MB + 69 MB peak temp; pre-reservation absent -> folded into R3
addendum_surface_results.13_durability: SURVIVES: flush+fsync+chmod+atomic rename+parent-directory fsync on every artifact; journal rewritten atomically (old-or-new, never torn); kill-test corroborated
addendum_surface_results.14_environment_freeze: required fix within R3 scope: no runtime pin assertions; f32 fixed-order surfaces are platform-exact (empirically bit-identical Linux vs committed macOS evidence) while f64 libm sigmoid diverges across hosts (measured: router_scores only) — the pinned CPython/NumPy doctrine is load-bearing and should be asserted at gate
addendum_surface_results.1_crash_consistent_banker: SURVIVES with required fix N7: per-artifact durability is real (write+fsync+atomic rename+parent fsync, empirically kill-tested); receipt precedes retention, so a crash can leave a durable receipt with absent packed bytes (demonstrated: receipts 00-03 durable, packed 00-02 only, no terminal); accounting stays deterministic because the contract defines N as durable receipt count and each receipt embeds the packed hash; the one-read window (read completed, receipt not durable) is inherent and contract-defined
addendum_surface_results.2_retained_toctou: required fix N9: validation and consumption open the path separately (lstat, sha_file open, np.fromfile open, verify_after open); before/after hashing narrows but does not close a swap-and-restore window; consume from a single validated descriptor (open once, fstat, hash fd, read fd)
addendum_surface_results.3_mutual_binding: SURVIVES: wrapper binds executor sha; executor gate verifies its own file sha, authorization identity, boundary v3, graph v2, epsilon adjudication, inventory tuples+sum, retained identities, flags; no legacy, fallback, or compatibility path exists; stage names compiled in and double-checked; rehearsal sha is review-time (validator) binding
addendum_surface_results.4_rehearsed_vs_final: SURVIVES: mechanical diff of the rehearsed candidate vs final v2 = exactly the 9 packed + 9 decoded synthetic hashes and the status overlay; non-semantic for machinery; residual: synthetic mode skips the FROZEN_RETAINED and executor-sha gate branches (static compares, covered by preflight/validator) — defense-in-depth D2
addendum_surface_results.5_synthetic_vs_production_path: SURVIVES: one executor class carries ordinal enforcement, retention, hashing, receipts, journal, banker, injection, vocabulary check, terminalization for both modes; substitutions are provider, decoder pair, and computation stage; the production computation adapter (compose_oracle + canonical name mapping) was not rehearsed by the committed generator but was exercised by this review at full real geometry (660 MB decoded, 1.9 s, 19/19 canonical names, 19 distinct hashes) — recommend adding to rehearsal (D1)
addendum_surface_results.6_real_geometry_resources: SURVIVES: retention and stage serialization at real size in rehearsal; decoded/compute allocations (~0.7-1.5 GB) skipped by zero-decoders but empirically exercised by this review; ~100x headroom on the 128 GB host; no plausible production-only OOM
addendum_surface_results.7_preflight_depth: FAILS -> R3: PRODUCTION_BINDINGS_RESOLVED (reproduced) proves wrapper->candidate resolution, executor sha, and gate flags only; no machine-local prerequisite is validated
addendum_surface_results.8_real_ledger_integration: SURVIVES within executor scope: single accounting mechanism (durable receipts), per-receipt ledger_after=166+seq+1, terminal ledger=166+N computed never assigned, reconciliations enforce read_count==receipts==9 and bytes==132900864, no rollback, restart blocked by ATTEMPT_ALREADY_EXISTS; the authoritative repo-ledger banker for this event is not yet bound (release-wrapper scope, N8)
addendum_surface_results.9_stage_hash_provenance: SURVIVES: every canonical name is serialized from the actual intermediate inside the hash-bound producer; the sole rename (attention_residual->post_attention_residual) is the same array; no copied, aliased, or reconstructed hashes
